author: Contributed Content
title: Ballad Health to host hiring event at Franklin Woods Hospital July 9 - NewsBreak
text:
By Contributed Content ,
13 hours ago Ballad Health is inviting job seekers to explore career opportunities at an upcoming hiring event at Franklin Woods Community Hospital, with positions available across clinical and nonclinical roles.
From noon to 4 p.m. Thursday, July 9, hiring managers will be interviewing community members for various roles at Franklin Woods Community Hospital, including surgical technicians, registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, certified nursing assistants and more. The event will also feature interviews for several corporate roles across the health system, including communications center specialists, flight coordinators, virtual safety companions and Center for Early Learning teachers and assistants.
During the event, job seekers will have the opportunity to meet with hiring managers, learn more about available roles and complete the interview process, all in one convenient setting. Interviews will take place in the Franklin Woods Community Hospital Family Birth Center conference room.
“Our team members give me a reason to be proud every day,” said Dr. Melanie Stanton, chief executive officer at Franklin Woods. “We work at an award-winning facility for one reason: the hard work and dedication of our team members. We’re looking forward to welcoming the next members of our team who will help us continue our commitment to our community.”
Ballad Health offers competitive pay and benefits in addition to opportunities for professional growth and development. The Ballad Health benefits package includes medical, dental and vision insurance, prescription drug coverage, short-term and long-term disability, a health savings account, a retirement plan, a flexible spending account and counseling.
Team members can also enroll in various voluntary benefits such as critical illness, accident, disability and pet insurance plans, as well as group discounts at many local, regional and national retailers.
Ballad Health team members also enjoy a discounted rate at all of Ballad Health’s Center for Early Learning child care facilities. Center for Early Learning–Johnson City offers reliable child care from 6 a.m. to 7 p.m. every weekday of the year for children 6 weeks old to 5 years old. All children enrolled at Ballad Health’s Centers for Early Learning benefit from an evidence-based curriculum designed to ensure that its students are kindergarten-ready.
Positions are also available at Ballad Health hospitals, clinician offices and other care sites across the Appalachian Highlands. Those who are unable to attend the event but are still interested in applying for available positions can browse and apply for open roles at balladhealth.org/careers.
